multi_entity_note: Transporter Arkansas Western Pipeline Co. and Shipper Associated Natural Gas Co., plus replacement shipper United Cities Gas/Atmos in the release forms.
processing_note: To be executed, prior to posting by Transporter, by Replacement Shipper only if Replacement Shipper has been designated by Releasing Shipper in G(i) above.

contract.document_name.rationale: The title heading is TRANSPORTATION SERVICE AGREEMENT; later occurrences are exhibit captions referring to it.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: After the ten-year primary term the agreement continues month to month until terminated.

contract.notice_period.rationale: Termination notice is 180 days for firm service under Rate Schedule FTS (the service selected) and sixty days for interruptible ITS service; the '180' occurrence lacks its unit.
